verdict.rationale: Cooley GO is a web-based document generator, and Cooley AI is a firm-owned AI service. For products like these, a tracking or telemetry opt-out is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, cookie controls or a usage-tracking opt-out. The Cyber/Data/Privacy item describes the firm's legal practice, not a product setting, so it is irrelevant.
